title: 50岁男子反复心肌病病例报告
originalTitle: Case 32-2026: A 50-Year-Old Man with Recurrent Cardiomyopathy
summary: 一名50岁男子反复出现心肌病症状，经过详细检查发现其携带MYBPC3基因突变。研究团队通过基因检测和临床分析，确认了该突变与患者病情的关系，并提出针对性治疗建议。

story.title: NEJM发表50岁男性反复心肌病与MYBPC3基因突变关联病例

author: Richard C. Cabot Eric S. Rosenberg David M. Dudzinski Meridale V. Baggett Daniel Restrepo Dennis C. Sgroi Jo-Anne O. Shepard and Lindsay MaguireDale S. Adler Christopher H. Newton-Cheh Shahmir C. Kamalian Margaret F. Lippincott Harrison G. Pope and Soma Jobbagy
